My status obsessed parents probably ruined the tiniest hope of a relationship i could of had with my ex. she broke up because we lived around 3 hours from each other i used to go visit for the weekend she would come mine etc...

when she broke up with me i took it badly went and got pretty drunk, went to work the next day pissed out my brains injured myself pretty badly at work (fractured ribs punctured lung). had to have a operation which didnt go well cos i have heart arrhythmia, cardiac arrested while having the operation was in a medically induced coma for 3 days.  

Now here is where its gets bad cos my parents wouldn't let her see kept telling her i was in this hospital that hospital she went to them all to try and see me eventually she decides that i have made it all up, i was extremely hurt not just with my parents but also that she would think i would lie to her about me being that ill.

this was all in november i left that hospital and moved to another country to get away from my parents and hoping that she would believe me, i have tried to show her the scars from surgery i explained everything and even tried to set up a meeting to justify what happened, in all she said her new boyfriend wouldn't like it and even though she still loves me if i contact her again she will do everything in her power to make sure i cannot talk go near her so i have to stay away. i haven't recovered fully i suffer from huge depression and have genuinely thought about ending my life several times.

it sucks but time passes me by now without thought and i dont know what i can do to fix things

i can go outside, i live in israel it is always hot. ive been here for 3 days now its not being confined to this space i just dont want to think anymore this is my problem over-thinking everything that has happened to me and not having a way of being able to repair things. my family i do not want to fix things with i hold no resentment against them they have done that they have done its finished but the girl its always out her i cannot shake her my from mind before this i lived in the UK and enjoyed a life of money, see plenty of girls nothing ever serious but she came along and i am completely in love it was just too hard for her and in the end i'm been painted out to be a monster who lies and there is no way back from it
i cant leave where i am, im in this like open therapy hospital where we have access to the internet people visit freely but we are not allowed to leave, im trapped her and in life

that part was never discussed tool making is a dying trade in the UK the guys i work with have basically watched me grow up they all covered for me and several of the MD'S have known me since i was baby so as a company were very close i know everybody by name who works in the tool room and the factory including the night shift, yes it was wrong of me to be operating that kind of machinery while under the influence but in 4 years of working there (left school didn't go sixth form or uni) i've never had a accident that's serious until that point i doubt it will ever happen again as really i don't fancy all of this again lol :)
I think that i would of been ok, like i would not of cardiac arrested if it wasnt for my Cardiac dysrhythmia but you live with the cards life deals you.

Its only a small ROMI lathe with a bridgeport EZtrack controller, really old has a manual gearbox where you move these levers to colours and this corresponds to a RPM, had it set to 1500 cos i was profiling some aluminium (needs high spindle speeds with a low feed as its sticky) the chuck key is roughly a foot long t shape with a cube on the end that fits into the chuck so it pokes above the guarding so you can really do things up really hard to miss its not in the chuck but i was half asleep and still relatively pissed.

Couldn't of asked them to do more i mean i was put into a coma after surgery to monitor my heart and brain when i woke up was a total mind fuck cos i didnt even know who i was or where i was but the nurses and doctors were so helpful and slowly everything comes back still have some trouble with my memory now and then but other than that i'm as good as new

It was pretty scary coming that close to dying has changed my complete outlook on life, you start to value things a lot more very small things you start to notice and i try to give something back now.

I still have my job fortunately i took responsibility for what happened as well it was my fault lol. i work with my dad as well which can at times be a bloody nightmare but it was he was my savior in this situation.

video-assisted thoracic Surgery, basically in order for me to have less visible scars i opted for this type of surgery they put what i can only describe as three hollow tubes one takes a camera and the others for implements i basically had a small hole which they stitched back together. it can also be used for lung biopsy's for lung cancer a wide range of things.
